name: Alice
description: A researcher who connects semantic models, mappings and experimental evidence to research questions.

concepts.label: Ontology Alignment
concepts.definition: Finding and validating semantic correspondences between terms in different ontologies; unrelated to a user's mental-model agreement by label alone.

concepts.label: Human review of semantic mappings
concepts.definition: A human inspecting, accepting, modifying or rejecting system-proposed semantic correspondences.

concepts.label: Mapping provenance
concepts.definition: The source definitions, evidence, transformations and decisions from which a mapping derives.

concepts.label: Human mapping-review decision
concepts.definition: A human decision to accept, modify or reject a system-proposed mapping in an explicit task; it is not disclosure or action permission.

concepts.label: Research talk
concepts.definition: One individual talk presenting research results, with a stable report ID; not a session grouping.

concepts.label: Ontology artifact version
concepts.definition: A version of an ontology that Alice studies as a research artifact. It does not define this agent's application schema.

concepts.label: Vocabulary term
concepts.definition: A class, property or individual term in a researched ontology artifact.

concepts.label: Mapping candidate
concepts.definition: A proposed correspondence with source and target terms, relation, evidence and review state.

concepts.label: Mapping set
concepts.definition: A versioned set of correspondences between two specified ontology artifact versions.

relations.definition: The research ontology artifact defines the vocabulary term.
The mapping set uses this exact source ontology version.
The mapping set uses this exact target ontology version.
The mapping set contains the candidate correspondence.
The review decision concerns this candidate, without authorizing disclosure.

concepts.label: Dataset
concepts.definition: A versioned data collection used as experiment input.

concepts.label: Experiment run
concepts.definition: One actually recorded execution with fixed input versions and configuration.

concepts.label: Metric observation
concepts.definition: A measured result of an experiment with an explicit metric and value; no unobserved measurement is inferred.

concepts.label: Research claim
concepts.definition: A scoped interpretation supported by recorded evidence, not by a generated summary alone.

concepts.label: Benchmark report
concepts.definition: A report describing experiment configuration, evidence, results and limitations.

relations.definition: The run uses the dataset version.
The run evaluates this mapping-set version.
The run produced this observed metric.
The research claim is supported by the recorded metric.
The report documents this experiment run.

fields.summary: Alice studies knowledge graphs, ontology alignment and reviewable semantic exchange.
